from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissionRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record of admission statistics for a single university from a Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="Name of the university, e.g., 'Beloit College'")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The academic reporting period or year, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    total_applicants: int = Field(description="Total number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")
    total_admitted: int = Field(description="Total number of first-time, first-year admitted students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityAdmissionRecord]
